site.approach: I dig into something until it makes sense, and what I learn only becomes mine once I've built it myself. Research, engineering, design — the attitude doesn't change. I want what I understand and make to settle into someone's day, and shift it, a little.
site.intro: Hi, I'm Hyunseung Ryu. I'm a graduate of Gwangju Science Academy for the Gifted, now studying EECS and AI Convergence at GIST. Physics, math, astronomy, and problems you solve through simulation have held my attention for a long time; over the past two years I've become someone who works across frontend, backend, apps, and design.
